name: retailpulse
description: AI-powered retail analytics: sales, customer churn prediction, demand forecasting and inventory insights (Streamlit, DuckDB, scikit-learn)

paragraphs: Retail analytics platform covering sales analysis, customer churn prediction (ROC AUC 0.802), demand forecasting and inventory signals. The live demo runs on the Online Retail II dataset (1,041,671 transaction lines); the relational bundle (about 10 million transaction lines) runs locally only, because the transaction file is too large for free hosting.

RetailPulse is a Python and Streamlit foundation for retail sales analytics, customer RFM analysis, demand forecasting, and product demand signals. The app accepts transaction-level CSV and Excel files and maps common Online Retail / Online Retail II headers into one internal schema.

The primary analysis source is the official two-sheet Online Retail II workbook, staged as data/raw/onlineretailII.xlsx. It includes invoice-level transactions from both 2009-2010 and 2010-2011, with invoice date, product, quantity, price, customer, and country fields. The loader combines both worksheets and applies the current positive-sales cleaning policy. The dashboard defaults to Online Retail II (primary). requirements.text: Then open sign in with an allowlisted account, and select Online Retail II (primary) to load both workbook sheets.

The app is publicly deployed on Streamlit Community Cloud, and the Compose/OIDC setup in "Production Deployment" is the recommended path for a secured production deployment, which still requires your hosting account/domain, OIDC provider credentials, TLS ingress, persistent-volume backups, and operational alert routing.
